concerns.text: "FR-003: System MUST calculate empirical Type I error rates by first permuting treatment labels to establish a true null hypothesis (Randomization Inference), and THEN simulating missingness patterns. The system MUST count the proportion of p-values < 0.05 across A sufficient number of Monte Carlo iterations per condition.." – the phrase "sufficient number of Monte Carlo iterations" is not quantified, making the requirement untestable. A concrete iteration count (e.g., ≥2000) or a statistical justification for the chosen number is needed.

"SC-002: The "tipping point" missingness rate is measured against the condition where CC error rate exceeds a predefined threshold (a modest relative increase over the nominal 0.05 level) AND the FDR-corrected p-value is < 0.05." – the "predefined threshold (a modest relative increase)" is vague; the success criterion must specify an exact numeric increase (e.g., >10% relative increase, i.e., error >0.055) to be measurable.
